variants.title: Jamin's interferometer: refractive index of carbon dioxide
variants.unknown: n - 1 of carbon dioxide at 1 atm
variants.note: Kaye and Laby give n - 1 = 4.50e-4 at 0 C and 589 nm; used here at 632.8 nm, where dispersion makes it about 0.5 % smaller.

source.title: Kaye and Laby, Tables of Physical and Chemical Constants: CO2 n - 1 = 4.50e-4 (0 C, 1 atm, 589 nm)
